scientific_integrity: All displayed moment identities proved using the stationary generator; existing free-particle and fixed-chirality methods credited. No claim of independent verification or novelty certification.

title: Exact stationary kurtosis and the chirality-reversal threshold in a trapped active Brownian swimmer
